text:
leo: evening handoff — quick watchlist before i sign off. long day but nothing critical.

leo: 1) KV prefetcher noise in eu-west: we've seen repeated alert flaps on `kv.prefetch.latency.p95` for two small bursts (23:04 and 23:18 UTC). metric jitter seems tied to a single prefetch pool (prefetcher-7). no user-facing errors yet, but tail latency spikes look real. i added a short silence while we investigate.

marta: ack. i dug a bit — prefetcher-7 showed an increased GC pause on host gcp-eu-3 around those times. not sure if that's root cause, could be a mempressure/backpressure loop. i've opened a ticket (OPS-1219) with logs.

aj: thanks. left a note to bump the prefetcher pod to 2 replicas there while we validate. can we keep the silence another 30m if it keeps flapping?

leo: yes, i set an auto-silence for 30m. if it recurs after that window we'll escalate.

simon: FYI — encoder pool (enc-pool-2) on us-west has slowly been trending up on queue length this week. not an alert yet but want to flag for the night shift. watcher shows ~40% higher queue for long-context jobs. i put a small dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/enc-pool-2/queue 

leo: noted. simon, can you add a short runbook step? if queue > 100 for 10m, drain and restart service, and open a PR to increase min replicas to 3 for enc-pool-2. i've left the canary tag on the restart.

simon: will do, adding runbook now.

marta: small heads-up on alerts: i've tuned the kv.prefetch alert to require 2 evals in 3m (was 1 eval) so transient GC blips don't flap it. rule snippet: ```yaml
- alert: KVPrefetchLatencyP95
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(kv_prefetch_latency_bucket[2m])) by (le, pool))
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: warning
```

aj: perfect. saved me a midnight page.

oncall-bot: reminder — nightly backups start at 02:00 UTC; if anyone plans maintenance in eu-west, nominate a maintainer to avoid overlap.

leo: quick logistics: i'm handing off to marta for the first half of the night (02:00–06:00 UTC). aj you'll cover 06:00–10:00. ping each other on the #eng-oncall thread if you flip.

marta: taking first shift, will watch kv prefetch and enc pools. i'll escalate to infra if GC traces point to kernel-level issues.

aj: taking the early morning. if the prefetcher spike returns, i'll coordinate with infra and we can trigger a rollback of the recent prefetcher JVM flags (PR #453).

leo: final note — no deploys planned until morning; if you need to patch, use canary then promote. attaching a tiny troubleshooting checklist i use: 
- check host memory & GC logs (`/var/log/prefetcher/gc.log`)
- confirm replica counts and recent evictions (`kubectl get pods -n prefetch`)
- look for correlated spikes in kv.miss.rate or network errors

leo: signing off. ping me if something spikes. :wave:
